posts.title: Neil Hannon's lost Promenade-era biographical poem
posts.description: Long time correspondents will be aware of my near obsessive love of Neil Hannon's band The Divine Comedy. I declared them as my favourite when I was an awkward sixteen-year-old and have held that line ever since. The first few albums - Liberation and Promenade - are particular favourites. They're full of songs about slightly literate, slightly awkward people trying to find their place in the world

posts.title: > Thailand colours of the day
posts.description: > LINK · 'Colors of the day in Thailand' on Wikipedia According to ancient customs in Thailand, there is an astrological rule (which has influence from Hindu mythology) that assigns a color to each day of the week based on the color of the God who protects the day or Navagraha. Following this rule in my current work notebook. Looking forward to pink-on-Tuesdays.
